meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的 Flask、Django 或 FastAPI 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux。资源组、计划、Web 应用若不存在会一并创建,部署完成后它会打印一段部署后信息并结束本轮,不再做健康检查。
howto.when: 当你提到“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”等关键词,或要求把 Python 代码部署到 App Service 时接管。Container Apps、Functions、非 Python 与 IaC 场景不适用。

say.text: 把这个 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 缺资源时会先建资源组、计划与 Web 应用

say.text: 帮我把 FastAPI 项目部署到 App Service Linux
say.note: FastAPI 会设置 uvicorn 启动命令再部署

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude deploys your Flask, Django, or FastAPI code to Azure App Service Linux. It creates the resource group, plan, and web app if they are missing, then prints a post-deploy message and ends the turn without health checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "Flask App Service", "Django App Service" and similar, or ask to deploy Python to App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, or IaC work.

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Creates resource group, plan, and web app if missing

say_en.text: Deploy my FastAPI project to App Service Linux
say_en.note: Sets the uvicorn startup command before deploying

say_en.text: Deploy my Django code to App Service, app named mydjango
say_en.note: All other settings are derived as defaults
